title: Practice Test 1 · material standards
source: Exercises to practice, First Test (F. Martinez) and its answer key
intro:
The teacher's order of work for bars:
  • Focus on ONE bar of the longest length you can buy.
  • Fit as many long pieces in it as possible, then fill the rest with short ones.
  • Use short bars for what is still missing.
  • CMU = used / bought. Same CMU? Keep the plan with the bigger leftovers.

exercises.text: A construction company has an order to build 5 garages. The structure needs 3 steel profiles (IPE 140) with a length of 5.4 m and one of a length of 1.1 m. The profiles are sold in bars of 6 m or 12 m. Specific weight per linear metre: 12.9 kg. The cold saw has a width of 0.5 cm, and the heat burns 0.5 mm of material on both sides of the cut.

parts.q: a) Total demand of steel profiles (m)
a) The highest CMU you can reach (%)
parts.model: Use the 12 m bars as much as possible: 5.4 + 5.4 + 1.1 per bar. The best purchase is 90 m: 86.5 / 90 = 96.11 %.
parts.note: Type the number only, without the % sign (for example 96.11).

parts.q: b) How many long and short bars do you order?
parts.model: Both 7 + 1 and 5 + 5 reach 96.11 %, but 7 × 12 m + 1 × 6 m leaves longer pieces (2 × 1.2 m), which are easier to sell or reuse.

parts.q: c) The supplier sells the exact lengths for 5 % extra. Take it?
parts.model: You lose 1 − CMU = 3.89 %, less than 5 %: no. The difference is small, so the key adds: consider other information before the final decision.

parts.q: d) Sell what is left at 50 % of 19.50 EUR/m (1 EUR = 25 CZK). Price in CZK, without cents
parts.model: The material burnt by the cuts no longer exists. Left to sell: 3.38 m. 3.38 · 19.5 · 0.5 · 25 = 823.875 → 824 CZK.

parts.q: e) The 10 m truck is free now, the 12 m truck in 2 days. CMU if you buy only 6 m bars (%)
parts.model: 16 bars of 6 m: 15 × 5.4 m and one bar with the five 1.1 m pieces. 96 m bought → CMU 90.10 %.
parts.note: Type the number only, without the % sign (for example 96.11).

parts.q: e) Stopping production costs 5 % of the material cost per day. Which truck?
options: The 10 m truck now (6 m bars)
Wait 2 days for the 12 m truck

exercises.text: A construction company has an order to build one garage. The structure needs 4 steel profiles of 5.6 m. They are sold in bars of 12 m; the supplier also offers 7 m bars (leftovers from another job). Ignore the cold-saw losses (the material tolerance covers them).

parts.model: Two 5.6 m pieces per 12 m bar: 2 bars, 24 m bought, 22.4 m used → 93.33 %.
parts.note: Type the number only, without the % sign (for example 96.11).

parts.model: One 5.6 m piece per 7 m bar: 4 bars, 28 m bought → 22.4 / 28 = 80 %.
parts.note: Type the number only, without the % sign (for example 96.11).

parts.q: b) Which length do you buy?

parts.model: You lose only 6.67 % (1 − CMU), far less than 12 %.
